response.overview: # Translated Text  The story follows Sya (Syamim Freida), a successful interior designer who never expected to fall in love with Aidil (Keith Foo), a widowed single father whose wife passed away and who works as an Administrative Manager. Despite their different career levels and each carrying their own past, the sincerity of their love leads Sya to accept Aidil's proposal to build a life together. However, after a year of marriage, Aidil's behavior begins to change drastically. Excessive jealousy causes every movement Sya makes to be tightly controlled—from checking her mobile phone and financial control to monitoring her daily movements. Trapped in an increasingly toxic marriage and losing her freedom, Sya finds herself at a crossroads, torn between whether to continue maintaining her marriage or free herself.
response.title: Ke Mana Hilang Cinta
